title: Risk Sensitivity and Stationary Equilibrium in Incomplete Markets
abstract: arXiv:2610.30956v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study stationary equilibrium and comparative statics in an incomplete market economy with risk-sensitive preferences. We prove that a stationary equilibrium exists for every nonnegative degree of risk sensitivity. With independent income, greater risk sensitivity weakly raises aggregate saving at fixed prices and weakly lowers the smallest and the largest equilibrium interest rates. With stochastically monotone Markov income, these comparisons hold when the lower risk-sensitivity parameter is sufficiently small or the upper parameter sufficiently large. For pairs of intermediate values, however, greater risk sensitivity can lower saving, contrary to an existing result in the literature, and can raise the smallest and largest equilibrium rates. An exact decomposition identifies the forces driving these reversals.

translated_title: 不完全市场中的风险敏感性与稳态均衡
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有风险敏感性偏好的不完全市场经济中的稳态均衡与比较静态分析。我们证明了对于任意非负程度的风险敏感性，稳态均衡均存在。在收入相互独立的情形下，更大的风险敏感性在固定价格下弱性地提高总储蓄，并弱性地降低最小和最大的均衡利率。在随机单调的马尔可夫收入情形下，当较低的风险敏感性参数足够小或较高的参数足够大时，这些比较结论仍然成立。然而，对于处于中间区间的参数组合，更大的风险敏感性可能降低储蓄——这与文献中的已有结果相反——并可能提高最小和最大的均衡利率。通过一个精确的分解，我们识别了驱动这些反转结果背后的作用力量。
tldr: 该论文证明了在具有风险敏感性偏好的不完全市场经济中稳态均衡的存在性，并表明更大的风险敏感性通常降低均衡利率，但在收入持续相关的中间参数情形下，可能出现储蓄下降、利率上升的反转结果，并给出了精确的分解来解释这些反转。
en_tdlr: This paper proves existence of stationary equilibrium in incomplete market economies with risk-sensitive preferences and shows that greater risk sensitivity typically lowers equilibrium interest rates, but reversals—lower saving and higher rates—can occur for intermediate parameters with persistent income, with an exact decomposition identifying the driving forces.
